description: M-FLAMPA solves energetic-particle acceleration and transport along multiple magnetic field lines within SWMF. It extends a single-line formulation for parallel calculations of solar-particle distributions. The resource is documented by CSEM; University of Michigan. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The existing SWMF record does not name this component; its specific documented function justifies a separate proposed model record with a parent link. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
